answer: Work-slot deposit burn. Each agent locks 60 POA to claim one work slot; the deposit burns if the slot sits idle or its work fails verification, a public lantern over every claim. A sybil spinning up 100 fake identities pays 6,000 POA and watches it burn, a cost spiral crossing a financial tundra where each empty slot returns nothing. One honest agent pays 60 POA once, keeps its slot by doing real work, and earns its share undiluted.
